description: Erreichbarkeitsanalyse Bahnhof Haggen, Stadt St.Gallen is a dataset listed in Stadt St.Gallen open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Geomatik und Vermessung, Stadt St.Gallen. Die Geomatik und Vermessung hat eine Erreichbarkeitsanalyse des Bahnhofs Haggen für Fussgängerinnen und Fussgänger durchgeführt. Der Datensatz zeigt die Gehdauer bis zu 30 Minuten in 5-Minuten Schritten. Coverage: St. Gallen. The portal files it under Mobility and Transport. Its keywords are Fussgänger, Bahnhof, Erreichbarkeit, Open Data Hack St.Gallen. The portal shows 6 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2021-11-02 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-daten-stadt-sg-ch-portal.
